title: Meme Sounds
description: Meme Sounds is a mod that makes you play popular memes in game ( and maybe troll your friend )
body:
Meme Sounds is a simple mod that lets you play popular meme sound effects anytime in-game. It adds funny audio clips to normal gameplay, making moments more chaotic, entertaining, and fun. You can use it to react, joke around, or surprise your friends with random sounds, making it great for light trolling and laughs.

Warning: Not recommended for people with epilepsy or sensitivity to flashing effects due to UI flash options. Please use carefully.

You can open the menu with B, then scroll or click through the interface to choose sounds and play them instantly. It’s easy to use and quick to learn.

Overall, this mod is made to add humor and fun to your game through well-known meme sounds and silly interactions with other players
